Optical fractionator with optical disectors (disector height 20 um, guard 5/15 um), 100x oil objective, Giemsa 40-um paraffin sections (mean measured thickness 39 um); nucleolus = counting item for neurons, nucleus for glia; ~322 neurons and ~579 glia counted per brain.

Neurons vs astrocytes/oligodendrocytes by chromatin pattern, somal size, nucleus size/shape, visible nucleolus and cytoplasm; large vs small neurons by somal size; microglia excluded. Narrower and less explicit than the Pelvig et al. 2008 criteria used by Karlsen & Pakkenberg 2011 (see README).
